{{Quote|As we speak, a fleet of one hundred twenty-six ships, seventy-five of them capital ships, is investing Sluis Van to block any reinforcements from that sector.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Pors Tonith/Legends|Pors Tonith]], to [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]|<ref name="JT" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a massive [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] '''blockaded''' [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]] in order to drive off any [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] reinforcements from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and its [[Sluis Van Shipyards|shipyards]], particularly during the [[Battle of Praesitlyn]].<ref name="JT" /><ref name="TNEC" /> Later in the war, during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], Republic troops from [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] also besieged the world.<ref name="TEGtW" />
